intro: Six months ago, Emperor Castellan VII, the Last Sun, died without an heir. That same night the Sunfire Crown shattered into three gems and vanished. The legions went home, and every duke, guild and warlord with an army began calling themselves the rightful successor. By imperial law, the next ruler will be named at the Council of Banners in Solace, one year after the emperor's death.

sessions.title: Festival of the Accord
sessions.public_record: Strangers who came to Millhaven's summer Festival were named champions by the crowd and defeated the Verdant Court's Challenger at sundown. The Accord holds for another year.

sessions.title: Hold the Bridge at Harrow's Ford
sessions.cold_open: The garrison left a week ago. Two hundred refugees are camped on the wrong side of the river, and the orc drums started at sunset.

sessions.title: The Black Gull
sessions.cold_open: The Saltreach Compact will pay a fortune to whoever sinks the Black Gull. Her captain swears he's protecting the coast, not raiding it.

sessions.title: Bread and Banners
sessions.cold_open: Two armies reached Greenhollow on the same morning, and both want Millhaven's harvest.

sessions.title: The Pretender's Mask
sessions.location: The Pretender's war camp, Ashen Frontier

regions.name: The Ashen Frontier
regions.feel: Ruined forts, old battlefields, monster-haunted wilds
regions.rumour: The Pretender's banners carry the old imperial sun — upside down.

regions.name: The Gilded Delta
regions.feel: Silk, canals, decadence, duels at dawn
regions.rumour: A Vareth prince is offering a palace to whoever brings him one of the Crown gems.

regions.name: Greenhollow Shires
regions.rumour: Millhaven still holds its odd little Festival every summer. Strangers who wander in tend to get roped into it.

regions.name: The Heartlands
regions.held_by: Regent Lysander Vael, the late emperor's chancellor
regions.feel: Marble palaces, masked politics, nervous crowds
regions.rumour: The Regent keeps a crown on a cushion in the throne room. Everyone knows it's a fake.

regions.name: The Ironspine Mountains
regions.held_by: Thane Durgan Stonecrown and the dwarven holds
regions.rumour: Smoke on Mount Kharag for the first time in a hundred years.

regions.name: The March of Thorns
regions.rumour: Harrow's Ford is the last bridge before the wall. Nobody is guarding it.

regions.name: The Saltreach Coast
regions.held_by: The Saltreach Compact, a merchant republic
regions.rumour: The Compact will pay a fortune for anyone who can sink the Black Gull.

factions.name: Order of the Dawn Lantern
factions.blurb: Sworn knights who want the Crown to go to someone worthy. They recruit Lantern-sworn heroes for one job at a time.

factions.name: The Regency
factions.blurb: The late emperor's chancellor, holding the capital and calling for the empire to stay whole under a council.

factions.name: House Ironhart
factions.blurb: The duchess holding the northern wall against orc and giant clans, and claiming the throne.

factions.name: Saltreach Compact
factions.blurb: A merchant republic on the east coast that has declared its independence.

factions.name: Stonecrown Holds
factions.blurb: The dwarven holds of the Ironspine, who want out of the empire entirely.

factions.name: The Ashen Pretender
factions.blurb: A masked warlord in the far west who claims to be the emperor's secret heir.
